fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-08-06, Eswari Selvam was allegedly struck by a person after a verbal exchange at Sindhu Garden Residential Colony and later sought medical attention. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-08-05 at about 14:20. The complaint was lodged by Praveen Kumar (9000000122) on behalf of Eswari Selvam, whose contact number is given as 9000000250. A motorcycle bearing the number TN-47-ZZ-1038 was seen leaving the area. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. Items referenced in the complaint: a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly attacked the victim during a heated argument.
fields.Keywords: assault, altercation, vehicle observation, afternoon, residential colony, motorcycle
